decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s core wafer-processing capabilities and existing customer base, so management would likely keep it unless results clearly fell below aspiration levels for several periods.
Carrier wafers closely match the firm’s stated direction toward handling and reusable carrier solutions, making continuation likely even if early sales are still developing.
As a flagship technology close to the established offer, management would probably tolerate some uncertainty and continue problemistic search for applications rather than withdraw it quickly.
The off-the-shelf wafer brand is very close to the core business and expands commercialization with limited capability stretch, so it is likely to stay on the market.

Glass-based circuit boards are comparatively distant from the firm’s narrow substrate focus, so if performance is not clearly meeting aspirations management is likely to reallocate resources back to core wafer products and development projects.
